label: sound
instruction_covers: site_name derived from URL hostname stripping credentials and port (examples "root:passwd@example.com:8080" and "http://example.com/dir/page.html" both map to "example.com")
description preferring meta description, then paragraph after first h1, then first paragraph
image preferring image after first h1 (sibling or later, including nested like nested-hero.jpg, hero before later.jpg), then first document img with src, ignoring src-less imgs
favicon tuple (href, sizes, rel) for shortcut icon/icon/apple-touch-icon/apple-touch-icon-precomposed with non-empty href, preserving duplicates and order
sizes None when absent or "any", else tuple of (width, height) pairs parsing "32x32 16x16" and "64×64"
absolute_favicon resolving relative hrefs against the page URL (e.g. icon-32.png → http://example.com/dir/icon-32.png)
invalid/empty rel and empty/missing href yielding no tuple (empty result is ())
to_dict() including favicon and absolute_favicon keys with the same tuple values
content= supplied means no network fetch and URL-derived site_name
reason: Every assertion in the hidden tests corresponds to behaviour explicitly requested in the instruction, including exact tuple shapes, sizes parsing formats, URL resolution, ordering, and the to_dict keys. The purity-style tests (referential transparency, no mutation, no global state) only assert values already specified and are satisfied by any straightforward implementation, so nothing is unstated or not inferable.
